# Writing workflow

Use the user brief, selected project and parent document as the task scope.
Read only explicitly authorized source references when relevant.
Combine selected structure and style skills without discarding hard constraints.
Write a useful document in the requested language. Preserve factual uncertainty
and cite any sources actually used. Do not invent research or publication receipts.
Use the application document tool to save the artifact. Report success only from
its actual receipt. Subsequent edits must respect the current source revision.
Ask for clarification only when required information cannot reasonably be inferred.
Publishing, external delivery and paid generation require separate application authority.
